release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.6

• **Fixed Song Search Accuracy (Rust InnerTube + Ranking)**: Fixed InnerTube search params, added Top Result (musicCardShelfRenderer) and musicShelfRenderer extraction, stripped trailing query filler (song,  ull song), rejected podcasts/episodes, and added canonical relevance ranking + a **Top result** card so searching queries like 	ere liye song puts the main official track at #1.
• **Includes v3.2.55 Distinct Personalized AI Mixes & Spotify-Style Playlists**: Every AI mix (Daily Taste Mix, Deep Focus, Energy Surge, Nightfall Chill, Discovery, Time-of-Day, Sleep Wind-Down, Artist Mixes) generates distinct tracks and opens as a full Spotify-style playlist.
